user.title: Tyre tracking
user.description: One entry per vehicle. Tyre sets are added afterwards from “Configure”, as many as needed.

data_description.vehicle: Names the device and its entities, for example “Alfa GT”.
data_description.odometer_entity: Leave empty if the odometer is read by hand: a field will then appear on the card.
data_description.initial_odometer: Where the counter stands today. Sets the starting point: a set fitted before the odometer is known starts counting from zero.

init.title: Tyre tracking
init.description: What do you want to change?

vehicle.title: Vehicle name
vehicle.description: Names the device, and through it every entity — “Alfa GT Odometer”. The entry is retitled to match.

data_description.rotation_interval: Kilometres between two rotations, for the reminder on a fitted four-wheel set. Zero says nothing about it.

odometer.title: Odometer source
odometer.description: Where the vehicle's mileage comes from.

data_description.odometer_entity: Linking the car's odometer saves typing it in at every swap. Left empty, a field appears on the card.

add.title: New set
add.description: Mileage is attached to the set, not to its reference: correcting the reference later loses nothing.

data_description.reference: Brand and model, for example “Michelin CrossClimate 2”.
data_description.pressure_front: Optional: the placard figure for the front axle, cold, in bar — the door sticker says it. Filled in, any pressure sensor becomes an alarm: 15 % under or 30 % over is flagged.
data_description.pressure_rear: Optional: the rear axle's figure. A pair is judged by the axle it is fitted to.
data_description.dot: Optional: the four digits of week and year on the sidewall, for example “3223” for week 32 of 2023. The whole DOT line can be pasted as it reads.
data_description.axle: A pair fits either the front or the rear, and can move from one to the other.
data_description.label: Optional: replaces the reference on screen.
data_description.initial_total: For taking over existing tracking. Can be changed later with “Correct a total”.
data_description.price: Optional, for the whole set. Divided by what it runs, it says which reference was actually the cheapest.
data_description.storage: Optional: where the set waits when it is off the car — “garage, left shelf”, “at the fitter's”.

manage.title: Which set?
manage.description: Each line says what the set has covered, and where it stands.

actions.title: What to do with this set?

mount.title: Fit to the car

data_description.position: Where the pair goes. It leaves the other axle if it was there: two tyres changing ends are still two tyres.
data_description.odometer: Reading at the time of fitting. It closes the count of the set that comes off — this is the last moment to say where the odometer stood. Omitted, the last known reading is used.

duplicate.title: Duplicate the record
duplicate.description:
{set}

A new set takes this record, with a counter of its own. Nothing is taken from the original.

data_description.reference: Brand and model, for example “Michelin CrossClimate 2”.
data_description.pressure_front: Optional: the placard figure for the front axle, cold, in bar — the door sticker says it. Filled in, any pressure sensor becomes an alarm: 15 % under or 30 % over is flagged.
data_description.pressure_rear: Optional: the rear axle's figure. A pair is judged by the axle it is fitted to.
data_description.dot: Optional: the four digits of week and year on the sidewall, for example “3223” for week 32 of 2023. The whole DOT line can be pasted as it reads.

data_description.label: Worth filling in here: two sets sharing a reference look alike in a list.
data_description.initial_total: Left at zero: a copy stands for tyres out of their wrapper, which is what makes it comparable with the set it was copied from.
data_description.price: Optional, for the whole set. Divided by what it runs, it says which reference was actually the cheapest.
data_description.storage: Optional: where the set waits when it is off the car — “garage, left shelf”, “at the fitter's”.
data_description.replace: “{title}” comes off at today's reading and moves to the history, the copy goes on in its place at zero.
data_description.odometer: Reading at the time of the change. Omitted, the last known one is used.

retire.title: Move to history

data_description.odometer: This set is fitted: the last kilometres belong to it. This is the last moment to say how many.

restore.title: Put back into service
restore.description:
{set}

The set becomes fittable again, and its counter starts again from there.

delete.title: Delete the set

resync.title: Two readings disagree
resync.description:
**{entity}** reads **{reading} km**, and the tracking stands at **{tracked} km**.

An odometer does not go backwards: this reading is refused as it is, and the tracking would stay stuck at {tracked} km for good.

Taking the sensor's value settles the fitted set at {tracked} km — those kilometres stay its own — and starts again from {reading} km.

data_description.resync: The kilometres run so far are settled at {tracked} km first, and counting carries on from the sensor.

adjust.title: Correct the total
adjust.description:
{set}

What you write here becomes its total, and the count starts again from there. Nothing else moves.

data_description.total: Kilometres to keep for this set. The count carries on from there.

data_description.odometer: Reading at the time of the change. Omitted, the last known one is used.

separate.title: Separate into two pairs

data.pair: Pair that becomes a new set
data.label: Label for the new set

data_description.pair: The other one stays with this record and keeps its history. Both pairs keep the same total either way — this only decides which sensors follow which.
data_description.label: Worth filling in: the two halves share a reference and look alike in a list.
data_description.odometer: Reading at the time of the change. Omitted, the last known one is used.

error.dot_invalid: A date code reads as two digits of week, then two of year — for example “3223”.
error.axle_conflict: This set is fitted and the other axle already carries something else: growing it to four wheels would declare six on the car. Take the other set off first.
error.replace_axle: Replacing puts the copy exactly where the original stands, so it must cover the same wheels. To change the count, add the copy without replacing and fit it separately.
error.vehicle_exists: Another vehicle already goes by that name.

abort.not_loaded: The vehicle is not loaded right now — fix what its notification reports, then come back here.
abort.not_mountable: A set in the history cannot be fitted.
abort.retired: Set moved to the history. Its mileage is kept.
abort.not_separable: Only a set of four in service can be separated.
abort.not_rotatable: Only a four-wheel set fitted to the car can be rotated.

mount.name: Fit a set
mount.description: Swaps: stops the outgoing set's count and sets the incoming one's starting point. Same as picking the set in the select.

tyre_set.name: Set
tyre_set.description: Name of the tyre set to fit.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where to fit the set. No effect on a four-wheel set, which takes both. Omitted for a pair, it goes to the front.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Odometer reading at the time of the swap. Omitted, the last known reading is used.

set_odometer.name: Record the odometer
set_odometer.description: Records the vehicle's odometer, without swapping.

adjust.name: Correct a total
adjust.description: Sets a set's total mileage. For taking over existing tracking, or repairing a mistyped swap.

total.name: Total
total.description: Total mileage to keep for this set.

retire.name: Move to history
retire.description: Freezes a set's mileage and prevents it from being fitted. The set stays visible, filed away in the history.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Reading at the time of removal. Useful if the set is fitted: the last kilometres belong to it.

restore.name: Put back into service
restore.description: Makes a set that was moved to the history fittable again.

unmount.name: Remove
unmount.description: Takes the tyres off a position without fitting others. The removed set's mileage is stopped.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Reading at the time of removal.

rotate.name: Rotate
rotate.description: Records a rotation on a fitted four-wheel set: each wheel moves to the other end of its side. The mileage is unchanged, the reminder starts again, and the pressure sensors follow their wheels.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Reading at the time of the rotation.

unknown_set.message: “{set}” is not a tyre set of {vehicle}.

set_retired.message: “{set}” is in the history and can no longer be fitted. Put it back into service first.

not_mounted.message: “{set}” is not on the car: there is nothing to rotate.

pair_not_rotatable.message: “{set}” is a pair. Fit it to the other axle instead of rotating it: two tyres change ends by being moved, which is a swap.

odometer_backwards.message: An odometer does not go backwards: {value} km is below the {tracked} km already recorded. Change the odometer source if the counter really did change.
